def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicates
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric (remove commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    
    # Filter out out-of-range body_mass_g values (2500-6500)
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    
    # Fix sex case variants
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.lower()
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum().to_dict()
    return result
